Loading a nonexistent language should produce an error.

```elixir title="Elixir"
try do
  config_value = %TreeSitterLanguagePack.ProcessConfig{language: "nonexistent_xyz"}
  result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("", config_value)
rescue
  error -> IO.puts(:stderr, "#{inspect(error.__struct__)}: #{Exception.message(error)}")
end
```
